(()=>{
 'use strict';const C=window.VeredaCommerce,S=window.VeredaStudio,sector=document.body.dataset.sector;if(!C||!C.sectors.includes(sector))return;
 const $=s=>document.querySelector(s),esc=s=>S.esc(s),catalog=C.load(sector);let summary='',payload=null,cart={};
 const slug={petshop:'companhia',pizzaria:'forno',salao:'ritual'}[sector],profile=S.read('vereda-profile-'+slug,{});
 if(profile.name){const b=$('.shop-brand');b.firstChild.textContent=S.clean(profile.name,60);document.title=S.clean(profile.name,60)+' · Prévia Vereda';}
 if(profile.headline)$('h1').textContent=S.clean(profile.headline,120);
 if(/^#[a-f0-9]{6}$/i.test(profile.accent||''))document.body.style.setProperty('--accent',profile.accent);
 if(/^#[a-f0-9]{6}$/i.test(profile.paper||''))document.body.style.setProperty('--paper',profile.paper);
 let timer;function say(s){$('#feedback').textContent=s;clearTimeout(timer);timer=setTimeout(()=>$('#feedback').textContent='',6000);}
 function readRequests(){try{const x=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('vereda-requests-'+sector)||'[]');return Array.isArray(x)?x:[];}catch{return [];}}
 function storeRequest(record){if(payload)return payload;const r={...record,id:'DEMO-'+crypto.randomUUID().slice(0,8).toUpperCase(),createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),status:'Aguardando confirmação'};const rows=readRequests();rows.push(r);try{sessionStorage.setItem('vereda-requests-'+sector,JSON.stringify(rows));}catch{throw Error('Não foi possível guardar a solicitação neste navegador.');}return r;}
 function invalidate(){payload=null;summary='';$('#order-result').hidden=true;}
 function showRequest(record,text){payload=record;summary=`${record.id} / DEMONSTRAÇÃO\n${text}\nStatus: solicitação de exemplo — confirmação não realizada.\nNenhuma mensagem, pagamento ou pedido real foi enviado.`;$('#order-summary').textContent=summary;$('#order-result').hidden=false;$('#order-result').setAttribute('tabindex','-1');$('#order-result').focus({preventScroll:true});$('#order-result').scrollIntoView({behavior:matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches?'auto':'smooth',block:'start'});
  const a=$('#whatsapp-order');if(/^[1-9]\d{9,14}$/.test(profile.whatsapp||'')){a.href='https://wa.me/'+profile.whatsapp+'?text='+encodeURIComponent(summary);a.hidden=false;}
  say('Solicitação demonstrativa preparada. Confira o resumo.');
 }
 $('#copy-order')?.addEventListener('click',async()=>{try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(summary);say('Resumo copiado.');}catch{say('Selecione o resumo para copiar; a área de transferência não está disponível.');}});
 $('#download-order')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(payload)C.download(payload.id+'.json',{...payload,summary});});
 function wirePet(){let category='';const active=()=>catalog.filter(p=>p.ativo);function draw(){const q=C.norm($('#search').value),species=$('#species').value;const rows=active().filter(p=>(!category||p.categoria===category)&&(!species||p.especie===species||p.especie==='Todos')&&C.norm(p.nome+' '+p.categoria+' '+p.detalhe).includes(q));$('#result-count').textContent=rows.length+' itens encontrados';$('#products').innerHTML=rows.map(p=>`<article class="product"><div class="product-index"><span>${esc(p.sku)} / ${esc(p.categoria)}</span><strong>${esc(p.especie==='Gatos'?'G':p.especie==='Cães'?'C':'&')}</strong></div><h2>${esc(p.nome)}</h2><p>${esc(p.detalhe)}</p><div class="product-bottom"><strong>${C.money(p.preco_centavos)}</strong><button data-add="${esc(p.sku)}" ${p.estoque===0?'disabled':''}>${p.estoque===0?'Indisponível':'Adicionar +'}</button></div></article>`).join('')||'<p>Nenhum item com esses filtros.</p>';}
  const cats=['',...new Set(active().map(p=>p.categoria))];$('#categories').innerHTML=cats.map(v=>`<button type="button" data-category="${esc(v)}" aria-pressed="${v===category}">${esc(v||'Todos os itens')}</button>`).join('');
  $('#categories').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-category]');if(!b)return;category=b.dataset.category;$('#categories').querySelectorAll('button').forEach(x=>x.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(x===b)));draw();});$('#search').addEventListener('input',draw);$('#species').addEventListener('change',draw);
  function drawCart(){const rows=Object.entries(cart);$('#cart-items').innerHTML=rows.map(([sku,qty])=>{const p=catalog.find(x=>x.sku===sku);return `<div class="cart-row"><div><strong>${esc(p.nome)}</strong></div><small>${C.money(p.preco_centavos)} / un.</small><div class="qty-controls"><button aria-label="Diminuir ${esc(p.nome)}" data-qty="${esc(sku)}" data-step="-1">−</button><span>${qty}</span><button aria-label="Aumentar ${esc(p.nome)}" data-qty="${esc(sku)}" data-step="1">+</button><button data-remove="${esc(sku)}">Remover</button></div></div>`;}).join('')||'<p class="fine">Seu carrinho está vazio. Escolha um item para começar.</p>';const outside=$('#delivery').value==='fora',fee=$('#delivery').value==='zona-a'?800:0,total=C.cartTotal(catalog,cart,fee);$('#cart-total').innerHTML=`<small>Itens ${C.money(total.subtotal_centavos)} · taxa ${C.money(total.taxa_centavos)}</small>${outside?'Entrega a consultar':C.money(total.total_centavos)}`;$('#prepare-order').disabled=!rows.length||outside;}
  $('#products').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-add]');if(!b)return;const p=catalog.find(x=>x.sku===b.dataset.add);if((cart[p.sku]||0)>=Math.min(p.estoque,99)){say('Limite de estoque demonstrativo atingido.');return;}cart[p.sku]=(cart[p.sku]||0)+1;invalidate();drawCart();say('Item adicionado à seleção.');});
  $('#cart-items').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;if(b.dataset.remove)delete cart[b.dataset.remove];else if(b.dataset.qty){const sku=b.dataset.qty,p=catalog.find(x=>x.sku===sku),n=cart[sku]+Number(b.dataset.step);if(n>Math.min(p.estoque,99)){say('Limite de estoque demonstrativo atingido.');return;}if(n<=0)delete cart[sku];else cart[sku]=n;}invalidate();drawCart();});
  function cartShortcut(){const n=Object.values(cart).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0),button=$('#view-cart');if(!button)return;button.hidden=!n;button.textContent=`Ver seleção · ${n} ${n===1?'item':'itens'} ↗`;}
  $('#view-cart')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{$('#selection').scrollIntoView({behavior:matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches?'auto':'smooth',block:'start'});$('#selection').focus({preventScroll:true});});
  const observer=new MutationObserver(cartShortcut);observer.observe($('#cart-items'),{childList:true,subtree:true});
  $('#delivery').addEventListener('change',()=>{invalidate();drawCart();});$('#prepare-order').addEventListener('click',()=>{try{const choice=$('#delivery').value;if(choice==='fora')throw Error('A entrega precisa ser consultada com a loja.');const total=C.cartTotal(catalog,cart,choice==='zona-a'?800:0);if(!total.lines.length)throw Error('Escolha pelo menos um item.');const r=storeRequest({type:'pedido',items:total.lines,delivery:choice,total_centavos:total.total_centavos});showRequest(r,total.lines.map(x=>`${x.quantidade} × ${x.nome}`).join('\n')+`\nRecebimento: ${choice}\nTotal de exemplo: ${C.money(total.total_centavos)}`);}catch(e){say(e.message);}});draw();drawCart();cartShortcut();
 }
 function wirePizza(){const form=$('#pizza-builder'),available=catalog.filter(p=>p.ativo&&p.estoque>0);$('#flavor-menu').innerHTML=catalog.filter(p=>p.ativo).map(p=>`<article class="flavor"><div><h3>${esc(p.nome)}</h3><strong>${C.money(p.preco_centavos)}</strong></div><p>${esc(p.detalhe)}</p><button data-flavor="${esc(p.sku)}" ${p.estoque?'':'disabled'}>${p.estoque?'Escolher este sabor ↗':'Indisponível'}</button></article>`).join('');const opts=available.map(p=>`<option value="${esc(p.sku)}">${esc(p.nome)}</option>`).join('');$('#flavor-a').innerHTML=opts;$('#flavor-b').innerHTML=opts;if(available.length>1)$('#flavor-b').selectedIndex=1;
  const options=()=>Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form));function update(){invalidate();$('#second-flavor').hidden=form.elements.mode.value!=='metades';$('#flavor-b').disabled=$('#second-flavor').hidden;try{const r=C.pizzaTotal(catalog,options());$('#pizza-total').innerHTML=`<small>Pizza ${C.money(r.base_centavos)} · adicionais ${C.money(r.borda_centavos+r.bebida_centavos)} · taxa ${C.money(r.taxa_centavos)}</small>${C.money(r.total_centavos)}`;form.querySelector('.primary').disabled=false;}catch(e){$('#pizza-total').textContent=e.message;form.querySelector('.primary').disabled=true;}}
  form.addEventListener('change',update);$('#flavor-menu').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-flavor]');if(b){form.elements.a.value=b.dataset.flavor;update();say('Sabor selecionado no pedido.');}});form.addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();try{const o=options(),p=C.pizzaTotal(catalog,o),r=storeRequest({type:'pedido',options:o,...p});showRequest(r,`Pizza ${o.size} · ${o.mode}\n${p.sabores.join(' / ')}\nBorda: ${o.edge} · bebida: ${o.drink}\nRecebimento: ${o.delivery}\nTotal de exemplo: ${C.money(p.total_centavos)}`);}catch(e){say(e.message);}});update();
 }
 function wireSalon(){const form=$('#salon-booking'),services=catalog.filter(p=>p.ativo),today=new Date(),iso=d=>`${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`,start=iso(today),endDate=new Date(today);endDate.setDate(endDate.getDate()+60);const end=iso(endDate);$('#booking-date').min=start;$('#booking-date').max=end;$('#booking-date').value=start;
  $('#service').innerHTML=services.map(p=>`<option value="${esc(p.sku)}">${esc(p.nome)}</option>`).join('');$('#service-list').innerHTML=services.map(p=>`<button class="service-item" data-service="${esc(p.sku)}" aria-pressed="false"><strong>${esc(p.nome)}</strong><span>${p.duracao_min} min · a partir de ${C.money(p.preco_centavos)} ↗</span></button>`).join('');
  const professionals=[{id:'alex',name:'Alex · equipe fictícia',color:true},{id:'dani',name:'Dani · equipe fictícia',color:false}];const time=t=>String(Math.floor(t/60)).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(t%60).padStart(2,'0');
  function draw(){invalidate();const service=services.find(x=>x.sku===$('#service').value);if(!service){$('#time-slots').textContent='Nenhum serviço ativo.';return;}const old=$('#professional').value,eligible=professionals.filter(p=>service.categoria!=='Cor'||p.color);$('#professional').innerHTML=eligible.map(p=>`<option value="${p.id}">${p.name}</option>`).join('');if(eligible.some(p=>p.id===old))$('#professional').value=old;$('#duration-info').textContent=`${service.duracao_min} minutos · a partir de ${C.money(service.preco_centavos)} (demonstração)`;
   const date=$('#booking-date').value,valid=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date)&&date>=start&&date<=end;let times=valid?C.slots(date,service.duracao_min,$('#professional').value,readRequests()):[];if(date===start)times=times.filter(t=>t>today.getHours()*60+today.getMinutes());$('#time-slots').innerHTML=times.map(t=>`<label><input type="radio" name="time" value="${t}" required>${time(t)}</label>`).join('')||'<p class="fine">Sem horários de exemplo para esta data. Escolha outro dia.</p>';form.querySelector('.primary').disabled=!times.length;$('#service-list').querySelectorAll('[data-service]').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b.dataset.service===service.sku)));drawHistory();
  }
  function drawHistory(){const rows=readRequests();$('#booking-history').innerHTML=rows.length?'<h3>Solicitações desta sessão</h3>'+rows.map(r=>`<article><strong>${esc(r.id)}</strong> · ${esc(r.data)} às ${time(r.inicio_min)}<br>${esc(r.service)} / ${esc(r.status)}</article>`).join(''):'';}
  $('#service').addEventListener('change',draw);$('#professional').addEventListener('change',draw);$('#booking-date').addEventListener('change',draw);$('#service-list').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-service]');if(b){$('#service').value=b.dataset.service;draw();}});form.addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();try{const o=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form)),p=services.find(x=>x.sku===o.service),minute=Number(o.time);if(!p||!o.date||o.date<start||o.date>end||o.time===undefined||!C.slots(o.date,p.duracao_min,o.professional,readRequests()).includes(minute)||(o.date===start&&minute<=new Date().getHours()*60+new Date().getMinutes()))throw Error('Escolha um horário futuro disponível nesta demonstração.');const r=storeRequest({type:'agenda',data:o.date,inicio_min:minute,duracao_min:p.duracao_min,profissional:o.professional,service:p.nome,total_centavos:p.preco_centavos});draw();showRequest(r,`${p.nome}\nEquipe fictícia: ${o.professional}\nData: ${o.date} · ${time(minute)}–${time(minute+p.duracao_min)}\nValor de exemplo a partir de ${C.money(p.preco_centavos)}`);}catch(e){say(e.message);}});draw();
 }
 if(sector==='petshop')wirePet();if(sector==='pizzaria')wirePizza();if(sector==='salao')wireSalon();
})();
